claim: Continuous improves registered verifier-defined C1 hit yield, with a validity/novelty cost
evidence: Five paired training seeds: hit 0.1587→0.1780; validity 0.5220→0.4547; novelty 0.5033→0.4313. Seed—not candidate row—is the inferential unit.
boundary: Does not identify independent conductivity gain; historical error/denominator conventions need reconciliation.

claim: Blind RF has poor known-tail behavior
evidence: 1,205 known tail rows; bin maxima below training maximum, Spearman approximately 0.05–0.17, nominal 90% tree-SD coverage approximately 0–0.25%.
boundary: Does not establish that every rank-based use of RF fails; R1 directly tests nomination quality.

claim: Zero RF crossing proves generative AI cannot physically extrapolate
evidence: Inspected code fits squared-error RF on lower-support labels, averages tree means, then requires prediction > max(train labels). That event is structurally impossible here.
boundary: Refutes the inference, not the physical possibility or any particular material. Known method property; no novel universal AI-limit claim.

claim: Original binary is a competitive informative upper-tail comparator
evidence: Historical cutoff −4.0 exceeds Q80 training maximum −4.084499; 0 positive / 4,819 negative training labels.
boundary: Retain degenerate binary as historical negative control; a separately named train-only top-quintile binary is required for fair competitive testing.

claim: Six-property zero hit proves adding conditions cannot help
evidence: 8,000 candidate rows; joint support 2,494/6,024; same type of surrogate restriction and changed data support.
boundary: Cannot isolate conditioning dimension, support, representation or physical capability.

claim: Continuous nominees have greater independent conductivity or more physical frontier crossings
evidence: No extrapolation MD labels; planned candidate rows are not measurements.
boundary: Neither success nor physical failure established. Comparison needs common protocol and comparable concurrent boundary reference.

status: Engineering HOLD, not a material failure
evidence: PCFF+ candidate bundles absent; PFP evidence-chain 39/41 checks and non-converged smoke do not close the gate.
boundary: Missing/unconverged outcomes must not become low conductivity.

claim: Fragment method is independently superior to PolyGen
evidence: MolMiner extended50 has 125 valid / 150 requests, 25 strict hits, five training seeds; support/checkpoint/budget differences remain.
boundary: Not a matched-support confirmatory leaderboard; Wee conductivity arm not tested here.

claim: Current data identify DP-driven or cross-chemistry system generalization
evidence: Existing PolyGen PCL prototype has 711 observations, one chemistry and one MW; group-CV RMSE 0.962 versus 1.261 temperature-agnostic null.
boundary: Can study within-PCL salt/loading/temperature diagnostic; cannot infer an effect of chemistry/DP that never varies. No MIT-repository work in this scope.

claim: Exact novelty establishes unseen-family chemical extrapolation
evidence: Structure disjointness is available; scaffold/family-disjoint matched checkpoints and controlled family evaluation are not complete.
boundary: Exact novel structures can be close analogues. Do not rename novelty a family-OOD result.

claim: Independent feedback or an agent improves discovery decisions
evidence: No sealed feedback-policy comparison or agent-planning experiment; planning/decision panels include synthetic placeholders.
boundary: Agentic relevance is motivation; no tested agent capability. Feedback versus DP extension remains a later one-of-two choice.
